changelog: 1. Manual mode removed: the speed dropdown is now 1x/2x/5x/10x only, and Play always works (previously it silently did nothing when "Manual" was selected). Next Bar and Prev Bar are always available for manual stepping regardless of the selected speed.

2. Prev Bar added (backtest_rewind). Steps replay_cursor_ms back one bar of the session's own replay timeframe and undoes everything that happened strictly after the new cursor, so stale P&L can never survive a rewind: a trade opened after the new cursor is flagged trades.backtest_rewound=1 (excluded from every equity/stats query, never deleted -- it stays in the trades table for audit); a trade opened before but closed after it is reopened (its close undone, entry left untouched, fee recomputed to entry-only via the existing pure backtestFee() function); a pending order placed after the new cursor is deleted outright (it has no execution facts to preserve); a pending order that filled after it returns to pending. Session status/pass/fail rolls back to active if the bar that set it is now after the new cursor. backtest_sessions.rewind_count accumulates how many trade outcomes were actually undone (not how many times the button was clicked) and is shown in the Challenge panel once non-zero. A step that would undo one or more trades requires confirmation naming exactly how many (two-phase: the endpoint only counts and reports back until the client sends confirmed:true). The replay cursor's own timestamp is now always visible in the controls bar, specifically so a rewind (which removes candles from the chart) is traceable rather than alarming.

3. Timeframe switching added to the replay window (15m/1H/4H/1D buttons, a distinct "Viewing" control from the fixed "Replay <tf>" label showing what actually drives the clock). get_backtest_candles now accepts an optional timeframe param, separate from the session's own replay_timeframe: viewing the same or a finer resolution reads the real stored series, clamped to the replay timeframe's own no-lookahead boundary (not a finer one) so switching to a smaller timeframe can never reveal anything the replay clock hasn't reached; viewing a COARSER resolution (e.g. 4H while replaying on 1H) reads real stored bars for everything already fully elapsed, and synthesizes the current, still-in-progress coarser bar from the real replay-timeframe candles that have actually elapsed within it (new backtestAggregateCandles() in backtest_engine.php, self-tested) -- the stored coarser series holds the real, complete FUTURE candle for that same window, which would leak lookahead if read directly. The same replay timestamp is preserved across a switch; lead-in history is re-fetched at the new resolution. Next Bar, Prev Bar and Play are unaffected by what's being viewed -- neither ever reads the display timeframe.

4. Chart no longer bounces vertically or re-zooms on every step. Replaced fitContent() (which re-fits to whatever's loaded on every single call) with a fixed-width visible range recomputed from the current candle count on every render -- mathematically equivalent to shifting a constant-width window by exactly however many bars changed, so the visible bar count and the cursor's on-screen position both stay constant while stepping, now with room to the right of the cursor (TradingView-replay style) instead of pinned at the edge. The vertical bounce itself was Lightweight Charts' own default price-scale behavior re-fitting on every data/range change -- a custom autoscaleInfoProvider on the candle series now starts from the library's own natural range and only ever WIDENS it when a new bar's price would actually fall outside, never re-tightens to a fresh fit, which is the closest this library's public API gets to "shift smoothly rather than snapping." Reset to a clean natural fit on a fresh session open/resume and on a display-timeframe switch.

Verification note: the browser-rendered chart behavior (absence of visual vertical bounce, on-screen zoom/cursor stability) could not be exercised from this environment -- confirmed instead by lint, the full backtest_engine.php self-test suite (29 assertions, including new coverage for backtestAggregateCandles()), and hand-traced boundary arithmetic for the coarser-timeframe aggregation window. Please run the ticket's own step-50-forward/20-back verification on each timeframe after deploying.
release_notes: MANUAL DB STEP REQUIRED, not run by this release: after Update Now, run migrate.php?mode=status then mode=run to apply migrations/2026_09_26_0001_add_backtest_rewind_support.sql (adds trades.backtest_rewound and backtest_sessions.rewind_count). Both ALTERs use the information_schema-check + PREPARE/EXECUTE pattern (MySQL 8.4-safe, not the MariaDB-only IF NOT EXISTS clause that broke migrations 2026_09_25_0001/0002 -- see CLAUDE.md v3.20.3).
